description:
What do you know more about than anyone else? From Paleolithic Flute and Filipino Jazz, Corsican Polyphonic to Nicaragua 1960-1985 - our Supporters went niche in this end of year series.
Missed out this time? Don’t worry – we’ll be broadcasting further seasons of Supporter Radio in 2025. Become an NTS Supporter and be the first to know about the next opportunity to submit a mix.
